_approach: 16-bar build compressed to three: bar 1 is the two-step groove, bar 2 drops the kick to just beat 1 while the snare roll begins at 8th-note spacing and grows, and bar 3 removes the kick entirely for an unbroken 16th snare roll ramping 60-127, hats thinned to nothing and the very last 16th left silent before the drop. Ref: KAN Samples' DnB arrangement guide (16-bar build: accelerating snare rolls, progressive drum intensification); MusicRadar's ultimate snare-roll build-up technique. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
